simple.meaning: חַלְחָלָה (chalchâlâh) is a Hebrew object word meaning “writhing (in childbirth); by implication, terror.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.

occurrences.englishText: Therefore my thighs are filled with anguish. Pains have seized me, like the pains of a woman in labor. I am in so much pain that I can’t hear. I so am dismayed that I can’t see.
A sword will come on Egypt,
“ ‘ “In that day messengers will go out from before me in ships to make the careless Ethiopians afraid. There will be anguish on them, as in the day of Egypt; for, behold, it comes.”
Where is the den of the lions, and the feeding place of the young lions, where the lion and the lioness walked, the lion’s cubs, and no one made them afraid?
